# XClass field labels, hints and list values. XWiki resolves the label of a field as # "<class reference>_<field name>", the hint below it as that key suffixed with ".hint", and the label of a # static list value as the field key suffixed with "_<stored value>". The sheets display their form labels from # these very keys, so that a field cannot be named one way on its form and another way in the object editor.
